scientific_integrity: Only the planar bracketing certificate and exact merge are new claims. Pairwise width representation and dominated-front pruning are expressly attributed to prior literature. No independent verification or blanket novelty certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite planar real point sets, exact comparisons, and sorted antichain inputs for the linear phase; unsorted inputs require sorting. Not a bound on floating-point errors, end-to-end solver convergence, or more-than-two-objective complexity.
title: A linear-size bottleneck certificate for planar enclosure width
